name: Fair Division
justification: Tiny statement, YES/NO answer, one parity argument; ideal quick race problem.
solution_sketch: Let c1, c2 be counts of 1g and 2g candies. Total is even iff c1 is even; if c2 is even split both evenly, if c2 is odd you need two spare 1s to balance the odd 2, so answer is YES iff c1 even and (c2 even or c1 >= 2).
